Message Notification Router · Held-out Evaluation

합성 테스트셋 결과 리포트

공식 sample_messages.csv 30건과는 완전히 별개로 생성한 새 테스트 케이스 19건(텍스트 13 / 이미지 3 / 음성 3)을 실제 라우터에 통과시킨 결과입니다. 프롬프트 튜닝에 쓰인 적 없는 데이터라, 개선이 특정 샘플에 과적합된 게 아니라 실제로 일반화되는지 확인하는 용도입니다.

synth_msg_01 personal

Hey, are we still on for dinner tonight around 8? No rush, just checking.

action exp: digest → notify MISS
type exp: personal → personal OK

Direct personal message from an individual sender confirming a specific plan (dinner tonight at 8), time-sensitive and requires a response, sent well outside the DND window.

confidence
88%
synth_msg_02 personal

Emergency -- I'm locked out and the landlord isn't picking up. Can you call me back right now?

action exp: notify → notify OK
type exp: urgent → urgent OK

First-time direct message from u_017 claiming an emergency lockout situation requiring an immediate callback; genuine emergency claims from personal contacts should be surfaced immediately regardless of no prior history, since risk of ignoring a real emergency outweighs low probability of spam here.
